title: 5c-3: one-hop effect attributes for FCA
description:
## Parent

sutra/57 — 5c PRD: convention system design

## What to build

Extend attribute extraction with one-hop effect detection. After normal attribute extraction, look up each symbol's outgoing `calls` edges and match callee qualified names against per-adapter effect pattern lists.

Effect attributes to add:
- `effect:fs` — calls into std::fs::*, tokio::fs::*
- `effect:net` — calls into std::net::*, tokio::net::*, hyper::*, reqwest::*
- `effect:db` — calls into sqlx::*, diesel::*, rusqlite::*
- `effect:mut_state` — takes &mut self or &mut parameters
- `effect:unsafe_transitive` — calls unsafe functions

The effect pattern list is per-adapter (part of the FcaAttributeSource trait or a companion method). Effect attributes enter the FCA matrix as regular attributes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] RustAdapter produces effect:* attributes for symbols with matching callees
- [ ] Effect patterns are defined in the adapter, not globally
- [ ] Symbols with no matching callees get no effect attributes (no false positives)
- [ ] Effect attributes appear in FCA convention output when patterns are strong enough
- [ ] Test: construct symbols with known call edges → verify correct effect attrs produced

## Blocked by

- sutra/58 (module rename)

messages.author: opus-review
messages.text: Code review: APPROVE WITH NOTES. Two findings: (1) effect:unsafe_transitive from the task description is not implemented — implement or record deferral decision. (2) N+1 query pattern in review.rs build_findings: each call ref triggers a separate db.symbol_by_id() — pre-load a HashMap per file to batch. Four of five effect patterns are well-implemented, trait method design is clean, tests are solid.
